description: BLUEPRINT design-board hooks: puts the pending-edit count in front of a prompt while the user has unsynced board changes, and tells a session at t=0 to open the board's summon channel when a board is serving this repo and nobody is holding it. Both are inert in every repo without a .blueprint/ directory, except that the SessionStart hook also speaks in a checkout whose git dir holds a /blueprint connect record, to tell it to start blueprint listen when no listener holds the summon socket. Plus the lane git guard: in an unattended lane (.work/lane.yaml present) it blocks the git commands that discard or shelve the working tree, and is inert everywhere else. Plus the note before compaction: in a Blueprint design run (Steward's worktree, <repo>.blueprint-worktrees/<session id>) the PreCompact hook asks the compaction summary to carry the run's note and the agent to write it with WriteNote; it is silent everywhere else and never blocks.
